title: Telegram allowlist is allow-all unless BOTH sender and channel lists are set: empty means allow, and sender OR channel is enough

evidence.note: lists parsed from env with || ''; an unset or empty value gives an empty Set
senderAllowed = size===0 || has(sender); channelAllowed = size===0 || has(chat)
a message is rejected only if BOTH are false (OR semantics)
the comment states the OR logic is intended (D-21, D-22), so this is a policy question as well as a defect

sibling_sites_checked: The only allowlist in the slice is telegramListener.ts:53-83. The credential gate (:47-50) only decides whether the listener starts. The regex intake, cooldown and processed set are SC-09 (AUD-BUY-021). Routing to stopped chains is AUD-BUY-011.
severity_rationale: S1, equal to the research suggestion. Code alone proves the truth table: no lists (the default) = every visible message accepted; only senders set = channelAllowed is true for every message = every message accepted; only channels set = same through senderAllowed. Anyone who can post in any chat the account can see can push a token address of their choosing into the buy pipeline (the safety bank still runs), which bypasses the intended trust boundary.
recommendation: Decide on card OD-16 the default (fail closed when nothing is configured) and the semantics (AND vs OR, or an explicit mode). Phase 24; nothing is changed in Phase 22.
